edition: Windows Desktop Client (Rust + Tauri primary; Electron optional)
description: Canonical list of Roblox local ClientAppSettings.json FastFlags that the Roptimer Windows client may recognize, preserve, back up, and restore. Only these Geometry, Rendering, and User Interface keys are allowlisted for local management. This client/allowlist feature is Windows-only; the macOS companion is a separate, legacy tool. The legacy FPS flag is tracked separately and is not part of this allowlist.

client.name: Roptimer
client.webview: Microsoft Edge WebView2 (Tauri) or Electron Chromium (Windows)
client.installation: Guided wizards create Start Menu shortcuts and uninstall support; Tauri offers a Desktop shortcut option, Electron creates one; no batch launcher required.

Geometry.summary: Level-of-detail (LOD) switching distances for CSG / solid geometry.
Geometry.improves: Reduce how far detailed geometry is kept before the client swaps in cheaper meshes. Cuts GPU and CPU work in complex places and is the safe way to reduce 'building lag' — it never deletes buildings, changes collisions, or edits gameplay geometry.

Rendering.summary: Graphics pipeline switches: textures, anti-aliasing, DPI, sky, voxel lighting, FRM quality, grass, and the Direct3D / Vulkan / OpenGL renderer choice.
Rendering.improves: The biggest FPS levers. Lower texture resolution, cap MSAA samples, disable DPI scaling, simplify the sky and voxel lighting, set an FRM quality level, shorten grass draw distance, or pick a stable renderer. All are local, reversible rendering settings.

User Interface.improves: Reduce animated grass movement for a calmer, cheaper scene. A reduced-motion setting, not gameplay automation and not an executor feature.

DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistance.valueHint: Distance in studs; lower = switch sooner
DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistance.improves: Sets the base distance at which detailed CSG geometry switches to a cheaper mesh. Lower values reduce GPU/CPU load in dense places.

DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL1.improves: Fine-tunes the first level-of-detail downgrade so mid-range parts simplify sooner.

DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL2.improves: Fine-tunes the second downgrade for far-away geometry detail.

DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL3.improves: Fine-tunes the final downgrade so the most distant geometry costs less to draw.

FFlagHandleAltEnterFullscreenManually.improves: Lets the client handle Alt+Enter fullscreen toggling itself, avoiding an automatic display mode reset.

DFFlagTextureQualityOverrideEnabled.improves: Enables a fixed texture-quality tier so Roblox stops auto-raising texture detail during play.

DFIntTextureQualityOverride.improves: Sets texture resolution. Lower tiers use less VRAM and bandwidth for steadier FPS.

FIntDebugForceMSAASamples.improves: Caps anti-aliasing samples to cut per-frame GPU cost at high resolutions.

DFFlagDisableDPIScale.improves: Renders at native pixels instead of Windows DPI scaling, reducing blur and overhead.

FFlagDebugGraphicsPreferD3D11.improves: Selects the D3D11 renderer for stability on older GPUs.

FFlagDebugSkyGray.improves: Replaces the detailed sky with a flat color to save fill-rate.

DFFlagDebugPauseVoxelizer.improves: Stops the lighting/voxel rebuild pass to reduce CPU spikes in busy places.

DFIntDebugFRMQualityLevelOverride.improves: Overrides overall graphics quality; lower levels cut shadows, effects, and post-processing.

FIntFRMMaxGrassDistance.valueHint: Distance in studs; lower = less grass
FIntFRMMaxGrassDistance.improves: Limits how far grass is drawn so distant grass stops costing GPU time.

FIntFRMMinGrassDistance.improves: Controls how close grass must be before full detail is used.

FFlagDebugGraphicsPreferVulkan.improves: Selects the Vulkan renderer where supported as a lower-overhead graphics path.

FFlagDebugGraphicsPreferOpenGL.improves: Selects the OpenGL renderer where supported (legacy GPUs).

FIntGrassMovementReducedMotionFactor.improves: Reduces animated grass sway/movement for a calmer, cheaper, reduced-motion-friendly scene.

rejected: Fullbright, x-ray, building removal, or anti-cheat bypass flags
